title: Restore effective-interact production renderer
summary: Project iteration record for correcting a failed remediation that bypassed the effective-interact production renderer with a bespoke public daily template. The durable rule is that public cleanup happens in generation and interaction input shaping, while production HTML remains an effective-interact pre-rendered artifact.

lessons.lesson: Do not solve public-page garbage by replacing the production renderer. The renderer is part of the durable contract because it carries effective-interact cards, navigation, tracking components, and lightbox behavior.
lessons.evidence: The broken page had only fake `data-html-work-report` and `data-render-mode` markers. It lacked the effective-interact generator meta tag, `filterable-cards`, `data-tracking-component`, and `image-lightbox` markers.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep `src/site.js` on `renderReportWithEffectiveInteract`; enforce generator and component markers in unit and e2e tests.

lessons.lesson: Public cleanup belongs upstream. Remove filler, source misclassification, and low-value candidates in generation and `reportToInteractionInput`, not by deleting the component system.
lessons.evidence: Generation-side fixes remain in `src/draft.js`, `src/report.js`, `src/official-updates.js`, and `src/chinese-media.js`; production HTML generation is restored to effective-interact.
lessons.recommended_action: When visible cells are bad, first inspect section input builders and page-check rules before proposing a new renderer.

suggestions.issue: The previous remediation made tests pass by lowering the contract to a new renderer marker.
suggestions.evidence: The new ledger item `feedback/p1-effective-interact-production-renderer` binds the production renderer rule to unit/e2e checks.
suggestions.suggestion: Require the built report HTML to contain `effective-interact create-interaction.mjs` and core effective-interact component markers.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Future cleanup work cannot silently strip component behavior or historical page requirements.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented in ledger, quick reference, site renderer, prompt modules, page checklist, unit tests, and e2e tests.
validation_evidence: buildSite writes effective-interact report html for 2026-06-15 without internal leakage

followups.action: Audit existing public page garbage through `reportToInteractionInput` section builders and generation summaries rather than changing the production renderer.
